Yes. Under the prevailing modern view, the felony-murder rule generally does not extend to the death of a co-felon killed by police during the felony, so the man's first-degree murder conviction for the woman's death will likely be reversed. The note's claim that the proximate cause theory is universally adopted is incorrect—modern courts widely reject felony murder for non-felon or co-felon deaths caused by police.

CONFIDENCE: 90
